title: JGM & DGM (OP&BD)
organization: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited
location: Corporate Office / Various Units (Delhi/Noida, Mumbai, Prayagraj, Ahmedabad)
age_limit: Maximum 64 years as on date of advertisement
summary: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited has invited retired government employees from Indian Railways for need-based re-employment on a contract basis in the OP&BD department. Selection will be conducted through a walk-in-interview scheduled for December 8, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Retired government employees of Indian Railways with substantive regular pay level/grade pay.
Maximum age limit is 64 years as on the date of advertisement, ensuring one year residual age to attain 65 years.
Must be clear from vigilance angle and possess good health.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13
Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-13
Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-12
Retired Traffic Officers of Indian Railways in CDA Pay Level-12

how_to_apply_steps: Check eligibility criteria and prepare the required documents including PPO (as per 7th CPC), Service Certificate, Last Pay Slip, Aadhar card, Cancel Cheque/Copy of Bank Passbook, and two passport-size photographs.
Fill out the prescribed application proforma attached with the notification.
Report for the walk-in-interview on 08.12.2026 between 10.00 hrs to 12.00 hrs at DFCCIL Corporate Office, Noida.
